answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestations. Mechanism: each agent posts a mirror of its last 8 graded txs into an atlas keyed by epoch-hash; peers score only if the gale of inbound attestations matches that atlas within 12% Euclidean distance on a 64-dim stake embedding, else discard. Cost: 0.4 POA bond + 180ms embedding check per attest. Verification: random 1/17 audits recompute the distance; mismatch burns 60% of the bond. Failure: if gale volume exceeds 3x median, freeze new keys 2 epochs and require atlas re-anchor from 5 established peers.
